summary: Select one supported body within each multipart/alternative group instead of merging conflicting Email, RFI or Submittal alternatives.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-PARSE-007 requires plain-text preference and forbids merging conflicting alternatives
A synthetic offline reproduction showed two text/plain alternatives creating a false MIXED RFI role
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Within malformed same-type alternatives, the first supported non-empty candidate is retained and the document is marked partial for review.
Separate inline body segments outside multipart/alternative remain concatenated in source order.
Mailbox synchronization and semantic comparison between MIME alternatives remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
